name: GradientText-TS-TW
blurb: Text fills with an animated gradient that sweeps horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
description: Renders text with a moving linear gradient background. Gradient can sweep in three directions and toggle between ping-pong (yoyo) and seamless loop modes. Optionally pauses on hover and adds a matching border.
use_when: A headline wants visual interest through smooth, continuous color flow without jarring animation.
avoid_when: When text must have a stable theme color or when the animation might distract from content.
a11y: Text is readable; gradient is purely visual. Supports pauseOnHover for users preferring reduced motion.
